kind: New retrospective frozen-artifact analysis; separate from EXP001--EXP015
training: None; no checkpoint modification, refitting, or threshold tuning
input_contract: Require byte-identical NASA archive/TRAIN/TEST bindings, verified score-export commits, released-model metadata, deterministic first/middle/last sampled weight replay, and cached EWMA replay for all 81 frozen evaluation channels
source_verification_exception: T-10 has no label and is absent from the pre-existing 81-channel roster. Its separate source-verification failures must be reported; never silently promote it to an evaluated channel.
common_support: Raw target indices 250 <= t < raw_TEST_length-10; reconstruct from source shaping and ten-output Dense metadata, never optimise offsets using labels
label_policy: Unchanged EXP012: 81 unique channels, first P-2 record, exclude T-10, inclusive CSV [a,b] -> half-open [a,b+1)
primary_analysis: Apply byte-identical HUNDMAN_ADAPT_V1 from the frozen EXP012 input bundle to released telemetry-scale scalar predictions and each frozen project stream on identical common support. Recompute all three roles after cropping, because final-batch boundaries can alter decisions.
primary_metric: Existing report-defined corrected event F0.5, explicitly a study-specific endpoint, not the published Hundman F0.5
secondary_endpoints: strict point precision/recall/F1/F0.5 without point adjustment
nominal occupancy and starts per 1000 nominal samples
within-event issued-flag rate and late/missed notifications
within-channel raw and EWMA average precision (macro across channels, no pooled cross-scale AP)
additional_pipeline_analysis: Run the pinned current official telemanom v2 ErrorWindow detector on released LSTM predictions. Preserve its C-2 startup exception and original ten-target telemetry guards. Disclose historical label-informed exception, batching and guard lookahead. The one required execution-only fix casts np.delete row indices to integer; no statistical changes allowed. Preserve and report any nonmatching native archive replay rather than relabelling it an exact paper reproduction.
native_issue_time: Earliest newly flagged batch-availability time, charging the ten-target guard its nine extra future observations and up to 500 startup errors. This is audit instrumentation, not an author-provided original notification record.
historical_receipts: Independently audit both initial 2018 and current official result CSVs against their own label-coordinate systems. Re-score their saved alarm intervals using the current frozen 81-channel labels only after explicit coordinate conversion. Preserve published numbers separately; never claim a paper-score reproduction solely because models are official.
frozen_regression: On full EXP012 support, recalculate count/strict-point/timeliness summaries from stored flags and verify against saved EXP012 channel CSVs before interpreting common-support results
uncertainty: 10000 paired-channel bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 20261016. Keep all three project seeds grouped within each sampled channel; release remains one fixed-fit stream, never cloned as three independent fits. Report descriptive 95% and 98.75% intervals for gcn-release and controlled-release on two missions. Fits, preprocessing, detector, and shared-incident dependence remain conditional and unresolved.
sensitivity: Report C-2-excluded aggregation for native and common-detector comparisons; report first/second P-2 label-record sensitivity without choosing the better result. No alternative offset, threshold, smoothing parameter, or model selection from NASA labels.
claim_boundary: Released-reference competitiveness is a descriptive end-to-end benchmark under unequal training exposure/input access and one released fit; it is not architecture superiority, operational validation, or statistical noninferiority. A faithful newly trained reproduction would be a separately authorised and versioned new experiment, not repair of historical outputs.
